How to choose between them

Carriers go on neat; essential oils never do

The seven carrier oils here are used by the spoonful. The five essential oils are used by the drop, diluted into those carriers at one or two per cent.

Pick a carrier by weight, not price

Grapeseed is lightest and shortest-lived. Jojoba is the all-rounder. Sweet almond is richer and better for bodies than faces. Coconut sets solid below 24°C.

Patch-test everything, twice

Once for the carrier, once for the blend. Apply to the inside of the forearm and wait a day before using anything new more widely.

How people use these

◌

A simple facial oil

Six drops of essential oil per 30 ml of jojoba gives a one per cent blend, which is the sensible strength for a face.

✋

Scalp and hair

Five drops of rosemary into a tablespoon of jojoba, massaged in and left for thirty minutes before washing.

♨

Body after a bath

Sweet almond or coconut on damp skin, which is when an oil actually works — it seals rather than hydrates.

Questions about skincare oils

What is the difference between a carrier oil and an essential oil?

Carrier oils are pressed from seeds, nuts or kernels and are used neat, by the spoonful. Essential oils are distilled, extremely concentrated, and used by the drop — always diluted into a carrier before they touch skin.

Which carrier should I buy first?

Jojoba, for most people. It suits the widest range of skin, it is light, and it keeps for years because it is technically a wax rather than a fat. Grapeseed if you find jojoba heavy; sweet almond if you want something richer for body use.

How much essential oil do I add?

For the face, one per cent — about 6 drops per 30 ml of carrier. For the body, two per cent, around 12 drops per 30 ml. Lower for anything our product pages flag as a sensitiser.

Will these help with acne or scarring?

We are not able to make claims of that kind and we will not. What we can tell you is what each oil is, where it came from, how it behaves on skin and how people use it. For a skin condition, see a dermatologist.
